lines.head: Introduction
sentences: Stroke.
What every Ambulance Officer needs to know.

lines.head: Why time matters
sentences: Rapid early assessment and treatment make a big difference to how a stroke patient recovers.
That is especially true when they reach a Comprehensive Stroke Unit, or C S U.
Stroke Thrombolysis Services, or S T S, are country hospitals with C T that also offer acute stroke treatment.
Some patients may be eligible for thrombolysis, a clot-busting treatment, but only if they arrive in time.

lines.head: Sugar first
sentences: Your first step is basic care.
Then measure the blood glucose level, to rule out low blood sugar.
If it is below three point five millimoles per litre, treat as per the hypoglycaemia protocol, and reassess the patient after treatment.

lines.head: ROSIER
sentences: Next, do a Rosier assessment.
Rosier is the preferred stroke recognition tool in South Australia.
Use it alongside a thorough history and clinical assessment.

lines.head: Who is eligible
sentences: A patient may be eligible for thrombolysis, called a Code Stroke, only if every one of these applies.
Stroke is clinically suspected.
The Rosier score is positive.
They were living independently before this event.
They will reach the C S U or S T S within nine hours of symptom onset.
And travel time is under sixty minutes.

lines.head: Where to go
sentences: Locally, Port Lincoln, Whyalla and Port Augusta hospitals are all listed as Stroke Thrombolysis Services.
The Comprehensive Stroke Units are Flinders Medical Centre, the Royal Adelaide Hospital, and Lyell McEwin Hospital.
Flinders and Lyell McEwin are listed for eight in the morning to eight at night.

lines.head: If eligible
sentences: If the patient is eligible, consult the E O C Clinician for authorisation to transport directly to the closest C S U or S T S hospital.
Request clinical support if the patient is unstable, or transport times are likely to be over twenty minutes.
Confirm the patient's identification, and a phone number for their substitute decision maker, close relative, or carer.

lines.head: Calling it in
sentences: Then notify Code Stroke to the stroke coordinator, using the S A A S Code Notification Line, or local processes.
Use Iz-bar, and confirm the Code Stroke eligibility criteria and your E T A.
Then confirm arrival by S A G R N notification to the receiving hospital Emergency Department.

lines.head: Not eligible or too far
sentences: If the Rosier score is negative, symptoms began more than nine hours ago, or the patient was not living independently, they are not eligible.
Transport to the closest C S U or S T S, or the nearest hospital, or consult the E O C Clinician.
And if everything else fits but travel is over sixty minutes, consult the E O C Clinician to discuss transport and destination options.

lines.head: Wrap-up
sentences: So: sugar first, Rosier next, check the time and the distance, and call the E O C Clinician.
Then try the eligibility checker on this page.
